description: SHADOW, awaiting diagnostics (#142). Bare "reproduce/reproduces/reproduced/ reproducing" verb uses that no _REPRODUCTION_ANCHORED pattern claims — every anchored pattern requires a results-noun object, a first-person subject or a failure/attempt framing, on the grounds that a bare "reproduce" is biology. The open question is how much of the computational-reproduction genre that costs, and it can only be answered by counting what this arm would move.
